name: Lalo
source:
A bovine beastman of small stature. His juvenile appearance belies a warm and reasonable personality; he is a spiritual support pillar of the beastmen community. He possesses a mysterious charisma whereby his presence alone makes people feel at ease.

He worships the "Nameless God" whose only extant teaching acknowledges the polytheistic nature of mortal belief, hence he accepts the believers of other faiths as fellow worshippers. His acts to bring about a peaceful coexistence for not just his fellow beastmen, but for all races and creeds.

[Spoiler] The leader of the community of beastmen in Dantor, he commissions Edgar and his guild to serve as security detail in his upcoming audience with the lord of Dantor. In the process he joins the guild.

After foiling the plot to incite a rebellion amongst the beastmen at their discrimination, he opts to leave the community to travel for a few years to learn more about human society. He vows to return to his community every so often to check up on things and continues to work under Edgar in gratitude for his help. [/Spoiler]
